_what: The variation formulas — every way a winner becomes new ads, ordered from closest to the winner to furthest (the owner, 2026-10-08: 'you're supposed to just do it on the actual winner itself. It's literally just rearranging the existing content first, and then we can make other types of adjustments … create formulas for them'). Tier 1 needs nothing but the winner's own footage. Every formula names what Meta will see it as (Meta, Demystifying Creative Diversification: iteration = same visuals; diversification = different look, feel, storyline, message) and where it lives in Meta.

sources.beats: the winner's beats in the Creative Index ($CREATIVE_INDEX_DB: beat) — section, in/out, words, frame
sources.frameworks: components/marketing-doctrine/ad-frameworks.json — each framework's section order and awareness entry
sources.swipes: the swipe library (Creative Index swipe_card) — tier 4 only

tiers.name: Re-cut
tiers.what: Rearrange the winner's own footage. Nothing new is made.
tiers.meta: iteration — same visuals; goes in the SAME ad as extra pieces, and Meta grades each one

formulas.name: Hook from inside
formulas.how: Open on a later beat that can stop a scroll on its own (proof · failed-solutions · transformation · product), then play the rest in the winner's order without it.
formulas.tests: which existing moment is the strongest first 3 seconds

formulas.name: Framework order
formulas.how: Re-sequence the winner's beats into a doctrine framework's section order; a section the framework doesn't use is cut; each framework carries its own awareness entry.
formulas.makes: one cut per framework that shares 4+ sections with the winner
formulas.tests: which argument order (and so which awareness entry) sells

formulas.name: Cut-down
formulas.how: Keep the hook, the strongest proof, the offer and the call to action; drop the rest. ~15s and ~30s.
formulas.tests: whether the short version holds the sale (Reels/Stories)

tiers.name: Layers
tiers.what: Same cut, new layer on top.
tiers.meta: iteration — same visuals; pieces in the same ad

formulas.name: New words on screen
formulas.how: New headline / captions from the avatar's language bank, same footage.

formulas.name: New sound
formulas.how: New voice read or music bed; Meta: music or voiceover on every Reel.

formulas.name: New shape
formulas.how: 9:16 · 4:5 · 1:1 crops of the same cut; Meta: ≥20% of the ad set 9:16 with sound.

tiers.name: Re-shoot pieces
tiers.what: Same script and order; new footage for some beats.
tiers.meta: diversification when face, setting or look changes — a NEW ad (3+ moves from what's running)

formulas.name: New hook footage
formulas.how: Generate a new opening shot for the same first line.

formulas.name: Re-cast
formulas.how: The same script played by a different banked person.

formulas.name: Re-set
formulas.how: The same script in a different setting from the settings list.
formulas.tests: which world she sees herself in

formulas.name: Re-style
formulas.how: The same script in a different look from the style list.

tiers.name: New structure
tiers.what: The winner's message poured into a real swipe from the library (proven-to-format).

formulas.name: Format swap
formulas.how: Pick a real swipe by evidence (components/distinct-six/pick.py) and run the winner through it.

tiers.name: New who
tiers.meta: a NEW ad set (ad set = avatar + angle)
